title: Kayak Rack 2-Pack – Wall Hooks That Carry 45 kg
seo_title: Kayak Rack 2-Pack – Wall Hooks for Kayak, 45 kg
seo_description: 2-pack wall hooks for kayak. Arm length 38 cm, load up to 45 kg, 4 screws and 4 wall anchors included. Black with yellow end caps.
descriptionHtml:
The kayak takes up the whole garage floor

It lies where it always lies – in the middle of the garage, in the way of the car, the bikes and everything else you need to get to. Lifting it up against the wall every time feels like a two-person job, so it stays lying there.

Two hooks, and the kayak hangs on the wall

The kayak rack is 2 hooks with a 38 cm arm length that screw into the wall with 4 screws and 4 wall anchors. The kayak rests in the hooks instead of on the floor, and the yellow end caps meet the hull where the hook takes it.

Features

  • Holds the kayak at both ends – 2 hooks included, one for each end.
  • The kayak hangs free from the wall – 38 cm arm length gives clearance to the hull.
  • Carries the weight of a whole kayak – load up to 45 kg.
  • Screw it up without hunting for your own screws – 4 screws and 4 wall anchors included.
  • The hook doesn't chafe the hull – the ends have yellow protective sleeves.
